findings.title: Current strip-path plus existing explicit-name helper is not an admitted flattened-netlist mapping
findings.detail: M416 is fully flattened, but the direct RTL SAIF retains u_matcher/u_balanced and u_adapter hierarchy. The repository's current helper independently derives 4,100 mapped register instances but constructs only one explicit pair because it ignores hierarchy flattening. Actual PrimeTime coverage has not been measured.
findings.repair_gate: Proceed only to a fail-closed mapped-annotation diagnostic. Build a complete hierarchy-aware name map or gate-level activity and require independently parsed coverage >=95%; otherwise stop before power reporting.

findings.title: The two FIFO TX bits are conditionally observable, not structurally unobservable
findings.detail: fifo_tile_q[1] and fifo_narrow_q[1] each carry TX=13,486 raw ns. They can drive contribution metadata when slot 1 is the live head. In this always-ready workload every live contribution is accepted and the accepted payload/metadata unknown checker reports zero, so no transaction-level X is observed; that is narrower than structural unobservability.
findings.repair_gate: Use the wording 'two internal slot-1 SAIF TX entries; zero unknown accepted transactions under this workload'. Keep TX disclosed and do not replace it with guessed known activity.

findings.title: The testbench time_ns display label is in fact picoseconds
findings.detail: VCS %0t prints 21,000 and 6,288,030,000 at 1 ps precision. Interpreted correctly, the markers are 21.0 ns and 6,288,030.0 ns. The UCLI enable at 21.5 ns yields the exact 6,288,008.5 ns SAIF duration, so this is a label defect rather than a window defect.
findings.repair_gate: Rename the display field to time_ps or print $realtime in explicit ns in future testbenches; do not reinterpret this sealed log.

findings.title: The activity population is deterministic systematic sampling, not a distribution guarantee
findings.detail: The workload is sample 0 and 16 of 432 partitions per each of four H67 bottleneck Conv3x3 operators. All 192,000 selected rows are real and byte-exact, but this remains a 64-phase subset rather than all samples, all partitions, the full network, or the full population.
findings.repair_gate: Keep subset activity and power columns explicitly scoped; do not call them full-population or paper power without a separately admitted representativeness protocol.

strengths: All run, subset, M410R2, M408, M411, and M416 manifest/seal chains independently verify.
The 64-phase selection and every copied config, row, and static PWP record are byte-exact against frozen upstream sources.
Independent decoding reproduces every functional population, contribution, and 48,435,456-lane ledger field.
All four protocol_error SAIF objects have T1=TX=TC=0, while 13,124 of 14,537 signal entries have nonzero toggles.
The UCLI $stop boundary occurs after the final PASS and before power-disable/report, with exact duration conservation.
R1-R3 diagnostics are fail-closed, physically separate, and do not contaminate the sealed R4 SAIF.

claim_boundary.scope: sample0, four H67 bottleneck Conv3x3 operators, sixteen systematic partitions each, 192000 rows
